simple.meaning: צְחֹק (tsᵉchôq) is a Hebrew word meaning “laughter (in pleasure or derision).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צְחֹק (H6712) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 21:6, with occurrences in Genesis, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְחֹק (H6712) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צְחֹק (H6712) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צְחֹק (tsᵉchôq) / H6712 is traced through Genesis 21:6, Ezekiel 23:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
